hero.overline: Digital Media Strategist — Strategy · Web · Data
hero.name: Gabriele Brunazzo

manifesto.title: Every brief. Same answer: find the right angle.
manifesto.body: Media strategy and digital craft in the same person. I design end-to-end Meta funnels — research, audiences, creative, budget — and personally build the sites, dashboards and web experiences that carry them.

hwyl.title: HWYL Studio
hwyl.description: Portfolio and commissions landing for an editorial poster studio. OKLCH design tokens, a hero that dissolves on scroll and FLIP thumbnail swaps with Motion One — all vanilla, zero build step.

financeDashboard.title: Finance Dashboard
financeDashboard.description: A personal finance dashboard built as a PWA: installable, offline-first with a service worker, the whole interface in a single HTML file. Data, charts and budgets always within reach.

carolus.title: Carolus Archive
carolus.description: A one-page digital archive for the painter Carlo Chiavegato, known as Carolus (1923–2015): paintings, photography, biography and criticism gathered into a spare static site, built to last.

sunnee.title: Sunnee — Meta Ads Strategy
sunnee.description: End-to-end Meta strategy for a sustainable beachwear brand: competitor analysis, two buyer personas with customer journeys, a TOFU→BOFU funnel across four campaigns, native Reels creative and a budget plan with optimisation logic.

ideight.title: ID.EIGHT — Strategic analysis
ideight.description: Strategic analysis for ID.EIGHT, a sustainable sneaker brand: touchpoint audit, context and market, target definition, objectives and positioning. From reading the brand to a strategic direction in 34 slides.

yoyo.title: YoYo — Funnel Marketing
yoyo.description: End-to-end funnel strategy for an accessible, inclusive yoga platform: market and competitor analysis, four personas, an AAARRR funnel with channels and ROI, a KPI system, A/B test hypotheses, problem solving on conversion drop-offs and a 12-month roadmap.

about.title: Strategy, and hands on the code.
about.body1: I'm Gabriele Brunazzo, a digital media strategist. I design Meta advertising strategies — from market research to budget planning — and build the digital products that support them myself: sites, dashboards, archives.
about.body2: Two crafts, one point of view: every creative choice has to answer to a measurable goal.
